title: Yucca Valley Planning Commission to consider flying saucer styled home at Tuesday's meeting (11/10)
excerpt: The Planning Commission will discuss the Building Plan Review for the “Futura Space House,” located at 57149 Farrelo Road, which includes a flying-saucer
content:
0:00 0:00

The Planning Commission will discuss the Building Plan Review for the “Futura Space House,” located at 57149 Farrelo Road, which includes a flying-saucer style single family residence and a similarly styled additional dwelling unit.

The Planning Commission will discuss an application to subdivide a 4.38-acre parcel into a 3.47-acre parcel with one 0.91-acre parcel on the corner of Old Woman Springs Road and Twentynine Palms Highway on the right side of the Grocery Outlet parking lot. An Environmental Assessment will be reviewed.

Finally, the Commission will discuss the construction of a new San Bernardino County Fire Station on Joshua Lane and Twentynine Palms Highway, including plans to “vacate an alleyway,” which would terminate access as a public thoroughfare.

The meeting begins at 6:00 p.m. in the Yucca Room at the Yucca Valley Community Center, open to the public with opportunity for public comment.

Gabriel Hart is an author and journalist from Morongo Valley, CA. He was a finalist for the 2024 Golden Mic Awards for his continuous reporting on the Morongo Valley Community Services District. His punk-noir novel On High at Red Tide is out now from Pig Roast Publishing, and he's the editor-in-chief/publisher of Beyond the Last Estate, a print-only magazine featuring "creative reporting on contemporary literature."
